summary: MoneySeeker Phase 2 tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passed. Frontend: full mobile flow verified via Playwright on the public Expo web preview — login, session persistence, search + query + quick pill + bottom-sheet filters, job detail + Save/Apply banners, Tracker status tabs, Resume add/list, Profile stats + Sign out. All core features work as specified. Only cosmetic non-blocking issues found (external logo URLs blocked in sandbox, harmless RN-web deprecation warnings).

issues: Company logo URLs (logo.clearbit.com/<domain>) fail to resolve inside the preview sandbox, producing many ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED console errors. The UI degrades gracefully to an empty avatar tile so it is not blocking, but the missing logos hurt visual polish. Consider using a lightweight CDN, storing logos in /assets, or a colored initials fallback.

react_native_issues.issue: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — RN 0.7x deprecation surfaced by an upstream dependency (likely bottom-sheet / reanimated). Non-blocking. Reference: browser console during search screen render.

'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' warnings when opening the filter sheet. Non-blocking but should be tracked for library upgrade compatibility. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/FilterSheet.tsx (BottomSheetModal usage).

action_items: (Optional polish) Add a graceful fallback for missing company_logo — either colored initials on the JobCard/tracker card avatar or bundled placeholder — so the sandbox environment (which cannot resolve logo.clearbit.com) doesn't spam console errors.

(Optional) Suppress or address the 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' and 'element.ref removed in React 19' warnings by updating @gorhom/bottom-sheet / reanimated to versions compatible with React 19 (or documenting the known-warning if versions are pinned).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projections everywhere — good.
Auth uses opaque bcrypt-hashed passwords + server-side sessions with 7-day TTL; token stored via SecureStore/localStorage in frontend — solid.
AuthContext bootstrap correctly handles Emergent Google session_id from URL hash on web and cleans URL after exchange.
Applications enforce uniqueness (user_id, job_id) with 409 — prevents duplicate bookmarks.
All interactive UI elements have testID coverage (login, search, filters, job detail, tracker, resumes, profile).
seed_data_creation: Sample jobs seeded via POST /api/jobs/seed (idempotent). During UI test the tester user saved+applied to one job; that application remains in the tracker (Applied status) — E1 can decide whether to leave it for demo or wipe it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_moneyseeker_api.py — run with `cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/ -v`. Uses seeded user tester@moneyseeker.dev/Test@1234. Frontend testIDs are comprehensive; use the same Playwright flow to smoke-test any regressions. Google OAuth is not automatable — presence-check only.
